name: Abyssal Cycle
description: The Deep Reach does not have weather; it has moods. Five abyssal seasons rotate through the calendar, reshaping pressure, life, and hazard intensity.

seasons.name: The Still
seasons.description: Calm water, predictable pressure. The safest window for shallow expeditions.

seasons.name: The Surge
seasons.description: Currents strengthen and pressure gradients steepen. Deeper zones become more dangerous.

seasons.name: The Bloom
seasons.description: Bioluminescent life flourishes. Oxygen demand rises but corruption seems muted.

seasons.name: The Hunger
seasons.description: Predators swarm. Creature activity peaks and thermal vents run hot.

seasons.name: The Tremor
seasons.description: Seismic instability spikes. Pressure and structural hazards reach their worst.
